headline: Gold Fund Gains 0.33% as Silver Fund Slips 0.12%
summary: The gold fund GLD rose 0.33% to US$367.82 on Monday while silver slipped 0.12% as gold miners gained on a day Brazil's stocks crashed 13.88%.
why: Precious metals often act as safe-haven assets when emerging market equities or broader global markets experience severe volatility or sell-offs.

impacts.name: SPDR Gold Shares
impacts.why: Rose 0.33% to US$367.82 as investors sought traditional safe-haven assets.
